data.name: Farhan
data.gender_notes: Farhan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ف-ر-ح (f-r-ḥ), 'to rejoice'. Farḥān means 'happy, joyful'. Its root is ف-ر-ح (f-r-ḥ). A common Muslim given name. Farhan is a Arabic name meaning “Happy; joyful; glad”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Farhan expresses “Happy; joyful; glad”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ف-ر-ح (f-r-ḥ), 'to rejoice'. Farḥān means 'happy, joyful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farhan total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
